isRegistered.description: The user has started Evrotrust registration process and has scanned an ID card. To sign documents the user should proceed to successful face recognition.

isIdentified.description: The user has has passed through Evrotrust registration and has been successfully identified.

isRejected.description: The user has been rejected by supervisor. Reject reason code shows exactly why.

isSupervised.description: The user completed all required steps for profile creation. Supervisor review of the profile has passed. The user can sign documents.

isReadyToSign.description: The user completed the minimum required steps for profile creation. In case of successful identity check (before "isSupervised": 1), the user can sign documents.

hasConfirmedPhone.description: The user has validated phone number.

hasConfirmedEmail.description: The user has confirmed email. The email is not obligatory in Evrotrust app for creating profile.

rejectReason.description:
Rejection reason code (present only if isRejected is 1):
0 - Unknown
1 - ID Card - one side is missing
2 - Not clear image
3 - Personal data is not correct
4 - Personal data is missing
5 - Cropped image
6 - Invalid ID document
7 - Incorrect name
8 - Incorrect place of birth
9 - Incorrect date of issue/expiration date
10 - Incorrect personal date of birth
11 - Incorrect issuing authority
12 - Broken, damaged ID document
13 - ID document partially covered
14 - Lost, stolen document
15 - Doubtful videoidentification
16 - Missing video
17 - Third-person is present
18 - Need for trusted assistance person
19 - Need for video call with an operator

      "annotationParameters": [

          "axisX": 100,
          "axisY": 150,

    {
      "description": "Annex A - pricing",
      "checksumDocument": "60303ae22b998861bce3b28f33eec1be758a213c86c93c076dbe9f558c11c752",
      "annotationParameters": [
        {
          "annotationText": "Signed by Evrotrust",
          "fontName": "Helvetica",
          "fontSize": 10,
          "fontColor": "#000000",
          "axisX": 100,
          "axisY": 150,
          "page": 1

    }

  "coverage": 20000,
  "certificateType": 1,
  "vendorNumber": "YOUR_VENDOR_NUMBER",
  "smsType": 1,
  "publicKey": "BASE64_ENCODED_PUBLIC_KEY",
  "urlCallback": "https://your-server.example.com/evrotrust/callback"
}"""

key = hashlib.sha256(VENDOR_API_KEY.encode()).digest()
authorization = hmac.new(key, data.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

paths = ['/path/to/agreement.pdf', '/path/to/annex-a.pdf']
